Oracle layoffs: ‘6am job cuts’ return as ‘We are sharing some difficult news’ email tells employees ‘your role has been eliminated’

Oracle has reportedly begun a new wave of layoffs impacting staff throughout the United States. Those affected were shocked to find their jobs eliminated when they lost access to internal systems on September 14th. Cuts were noted in various departments, such as OCI security and NetSuite sales.
